title: Legal actions per decision, by phase
source: Engine-arena structure run fcd6c0c1-af77-4d2f-b43d-5c598f8d5ff5: 64 builder games (fast, ETA, fast, ETA) on seeds 0-63; 21840 decisions after setup and 12578 sampled searches.
caption: Bars are medians over builder-game decisions; the interval marks the 10th to 90th percentile. The main phase lists every legal build, exchange, and card play the server enumerates.
